SolidLSP portions adapted to C++ in src/lsp.cpp:
  Serena 2.0.0 src/solidlsp/ls.py (document-symbol normalization, sibling overload indices,
  reverse-position text-edit application) and src/solidlsp/language_servers/lua_ls.py
  (Lua method/function name normalization).
